Only Admin users can create API tokens. To learn more about Admins, see Roles & User Management . Some common use cases for our API include: Fetching information about customers Fetching information about issues Creating issues programmatically Check out our API Reference for specifications on all endpoints. To call the API from TypeScript, Python, or Go, use our SDKs , with pinned installation commands and upgrade guidance for each language. Prefer the terminal? Try our experimental Pylon CLI . It’s an early release and may change.
